name: chanlun-okx-plugin
description: OKX Chanlun Visualizer Plugin V1.1 multi-timeframe research edition

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --dir apps/extension typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run packages/core/test packages/broker/test packages/risk-engine/test packages/strategies/test packages/optimizer/test && pnpm --dir apps/extension test && pnpm --dir apps/desktop test
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --dir apps/extension build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop build
